podcast.title: Uncredited First Record (1952)
podcast.body: In 1952, The Debenares, including Richard Berry and Cornell Gunter, recorded their first record for John Dolphin's Dolphins of Hollywood. They were disappointed when it was released credited to The Hollywood Blue Jays, another name Dolphin used, and failed to achieve any success. "The group was disappointed when the record came out to discover that it wasn't credited to the Debenares, but instead to the Hollywood Blue Jays, and named Dolphin had also used for the groups."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Arthur Lee May's Baseball Career Conflict
podcast.body: The group was originally led by Arthur Lee May, a major league baseball player, whose professional commitments limited his availability for recording. He eventually departed the group due to time constraints. "May was a majorly baseball player, and couldn't record in the month's main career was taking up his time. May soon left the group"

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
